STARTERS.name: ‘RAMA’ PLATTER (N)	(For two or more)
STARTERS.description: (A mixed starter, £11.25 per person minimum for 2 people) Consists of chicken satay, prawns tempura, vegetable spring rolls, pork spare ribs and prawn on toast served with spicy carrot, swede and fine bean salad. Mild

STARTERS.name: SEAFOOD PLATTER (For two or more)
STARTERS.description: (A selection of charcoal grilled, £17.25 per person minimum for 2 people) Consists of king prawns, grilled sea bass fillet, steamed mussels, salt & pepper squid served with spicy carrot, swede and fine bean salad and spicy homemade sauce Mild
